facts.pillars-bj: She sits between a black pillar (B) on the left and a white pillar (J) on the right.
facts.veil: The curtain behind her is covered with a pattern of red pomegranates and green palm leaves.
facts.tora-scroll: A scroll on her lap shows the letters "TORA", partly hidden by the fold of her robe.
facts.horned-crown: On her head is a crown that curves out like a horn on each side, with a round disc in the middle.
facts.white-cross: A white cross sits on her chest.
facts.crescent-feet: A yellow crescent moon lies at her feet.
facts.blue-robe: She wears a blue cloak over a white garment, and the hem flows down to the floor like waves.

glosses.pillars-bj: She watches from between the two instead of choosing one.
glosses.veil: Something not yet revealed lies behind the curtain.

reversedGloss.internalized: She keeps what she feels inside and cannot bring it out.
reversedGloss.excess: Holding back words goes so far that it feels like a wall.
reversedGloss.blocked: Busyness and noise cover her intuition, so it is hard to hear.

misdescriptions.wrong: She is opening a book and reading.
The white pillar is on the left and the black pillar is on the right.
A full moon hangs in the night sky.
